# Grooming Studio MVP – Thin Prototype Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** A mobile web app where a user uploads 3 photos + 3 inputs and gets a 4-card Blueprint generated by Claude from the knowledge base, with no storage of photos, plus an offline eval CLI for calibrating the rules.

**Architecture:** Next.js (App Router, TypeScript) app on serverless. The client resizes photos to JPEG ≤ 1024 px and POSTs base64 JSON to `/api/analyze`. The server assembles the system prompt (`prompts/system.md` + `knowledge-base/*.md`), calls Claude with structured output, validates the result against `docs/product/blueprint.schema.json` plus guardrails, retries once, and returns JSON that the UI renders as cards. Everything is stateless.

**Tech Stack:** Node 22, Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript (strict), Tailwind CSS 4, `@anthropic-ai/sdk`, `ajv` (draft 2020-12), Vitest + @testing-library/react + jsdom, `html-to-image`, `sharp` + `tsx` (eval CLI only).

**Spec:** `docs/product/01-prd.md` (requirements P0-1 … P0-9), `docs/product/02-technical-architecture.md`, `docs/product/05-blueprint-output-contract.md`, schema `docs/product/blueprint.schema.json`, backlog `docs/product/06-week1-backlog.md` (W1-10, W1-11). The Slovak versions are the source of truth.

## Rulings made while writing this plan

- **Ruling:** Provider = Anthropic Claude, default model `claude-opus-5-5`, overridable via env `ANTHROPIC_MODEL`; effort via `ANTHROPIC_EFFORT` (default `medium`). Recorded as a *provisional* ADR (Task 10); PRD Q1 stays open until the eval compares cost/latency. — Why: the stack must call a real model now, and the model is swappable behind one interface. — Cost if wrong: replace one file (`src/lib/analyze/model-client.ts`).
- **Ruling:** Refusals: requests use the server-side fallback beta (`betas: ["server-side-fallback-2026-07-01"]`, `fallbacks: "default"`) on `client.beta.messages.create`; a final `stop_reason: "refusal"` fails the analysis without retry. — Why: Claude API guidance for this model. — Cost if wrong: delete two request fields.
- **Ruling:** The JSON schema in `docs/product/blueprint.schema.json` is the single source of truth and the code imports it from there. Keywords the structured-output API doesn't support are stripped for the model copy, and the full schema is enforced server-side with ajv. — Why: the contract doc already names this file. — Cost if wrong: a path change.
- **Ruling:** Only JPEG is accepted by the API (the client always re-encodes to JPEG). — Why: one format, and re-encoding strips EXIF. — Cost if wrong: extend one magic-byte check.
- **Ruling:** Rate limiting and the beta-code gate (implementation plan task 2.16, P1) are **not** in this plan. — Why: P1, and a closed beta with 20 users. — Cost if wrong: API spend from abuse; mitigated by a provider budget alert.
- **Ruling:** Free-text feedback (P0-9) is POSTed to `/api/feedback`, which forwards it to `FEEDBACK_WEBHOOK_URL` if set and otherwise logs it to the server console (text only). Thumbs up/down is the analytics event `feedback_submitted`. — Why: no DB in v1. — Cost if wrong: feedback lost when no webhook is configured.
- **Ruling:** Analytics = Plausible-compatible `window.plausible`, enabled only when `NEXT_PUBLIC_PLAUSIBLE_DOMAIN` is set; otherwise a no-op. — Cost if wrong: one wrapper file.
- **Ruling:** Dev-only mock mode: `ANALYZE_MOCK=fixture` returns the contract fixture instead of calling Claude, and is ignored when `NODE_ENV === "production"`. — Why: lets the UI and smoke tests run without an API key.
- **Ruling:** Guardrail blacklist drops `pekn*` and `hodnotenie` from the backlog's example list (they are common neutral Slovak words that would cause false positives). The exact list is in Task 2.

## Global Constraints

- Photos are never written to disk, storage, logs, analytics or error reports; server logs may contain only request id, duration, status and payload size (PRD P0-1).
- Photos are never put in `localStorage` / `IndexedDB`; client state lives in memory only (architecture §4).
- Client resizes every photo to max **1024 px** on the longer side, re-encodes as **JPEG quality 0.85** (strips EXIF) before upload.
- API accepts JPEG only; each decoded photo ≤ **1 500 000 bytes**; `height_cm` integer **140–220**; `hair_type` ∈ `straight | wavy | curly | thinning`; `preferred_style` ∈ `casual | smart_casual | streetwear | minimal`; `locale` = `"sk"`; `measurements` must be `null` or absent.
- Model output must pass the full `blueprint.schema.json` + guardrails; on failure **exactly one** automatic retry, then error (PRD P0-5).
- Route `/api/analyze` sets `export const maxDuration = 60`; p95 target < 45 s.
- UI copy is Slovak, informal ("ty"), and lives in `src/i18n/sk.ts`; no attractiveness language anywhere in the UI.
- Analytics event names, exactly: `landing_view`, `consent_given`, `photos_completed`, `submit`, `blueprint_rendered`, `blueprint_error`, `cheatsheet_copy`, `cheatsheet_save_image`, `feedback_submitted`. The `ref` URL param (`/^[a-z0-9_-]{1,16}$/i`) is attached to every event.
- All 4 cards readable at **360 px** width with no horizontal scroll.
- "Save as image" generates the PNG on the client only (no upload).
- Consent: an 18+ consent checkbox must be checked before any photo can be added (P0-2).
- Privacy copy must say: *„Fotky neukladáme. Spracujú sa len počas analýzy a hneď sa zahodia.“* and must never claim photos don't leave the phone.
- Env vars: `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, `ANTHROPIC_MODEL` (default `claude-opus-5-5`), `ANTHROPIC_EFFORT` (default `medium`), `ANALYZE_MOCK`, `FEEDBACK_WEBHOOK_URL`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_PLAUSIBLE_DOMAIN`. Documented in `.env.example`.
- Commit messages end with the session's attribution trailer lines (given to each implementer in the dispatch).

## Review Focus

1. **Photo the browser can't decode or that is huge** (iPhone HEIC on desktop Chrome, a 12 MP JPEG, a non-image file): the slot shows a friendly Slovak error and stays empty, nothing is uploaded, and other slots keep their photos. → test in Task 8.
2. **Double submit / tapping submit while loading:** exactly one request is in flight, and the submit action is ignored outside the `form` step. → test in Task 8 (reducer).
3. **Network failure or client timeout (no response in 70 s):** the error step keeps all photos and inputs in memory, and "Skúsiť znova" resends the same payload without re-filling the form. → test in Task 8 (reducer) and Task 9 (error view).
4. **Malformed / oversized / non-JPEG request body:** the API answers 400 with `{error:"invalid_request"}`, never 500, and never echoes the body. → tests in Task 4 and Task 6.
5. **Errors thrown while a request is processed** (model throws, JSON parse fails): nothing that is logged contains photo base64. → test in Task 6 (spy on `console.*`, assert no `/9j/` substring).

### Task 2: Guardrails module (W1-10)

**Files:**
- Create: `src/lib/guardrails/index.ts`
- Test: `src/lib/guardrails/index.test.ts`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `validateBlueprintSchema` (Task 1), fixtures.
- Produces: `checkBlueprint(data: unknown): GuardrailResult` where `GuardrailResult = { ok: true; data: BlueprintResponse; violations: [] } | { ok: false; violations: string[] }`; `export const BANNED_PATTERNS: RegExp[]`.

Rules (each violation is a short English string starting with a rule code):
1. `SCHEMA:` – any schema error (stop further checks if schema fails).
2. `STATUS:` – `status:"ok"` requires `blueprint !== null` and `photo_issues.length === 0`; `status:"photo_issue"` requires `blueprint === null` and `photo_issues.length >= 1`.
3. `ROUTINE:` – routine steps are exactly `{1,2,3}`, each once.
4. `PALETTE:` – at least 2 colors with `where_to_wear === "top_near_face"`; hex values unique (case-insensitive).
5. `BARBER:` – at least one `instructions_for_barber` line matches `/\d+\s*mm/i`.
6. `BANNED:` – any string anywhere in the response (recursive walk) matches one of `BANNED_PATTERNS`; violation names the JSON path. Patterns (case-insensitive, Unicode): `/\b\d{1,2}\s*\/\s*10\b/`, `/skór/`, `/atraktív/`, `/atraktiv/`, `/\battractive/`, `/unattractive/`, `/škared/`, `/oškliv/`, `/nepekn/`, `/\bugly\b/`, `/\bhandsome\b/`, `/\bflaws?\b/`, `/nedostat(ok|ky|kom|kami)\b/`, `/problematick/`, `/problém s pleťou/`.

- [ ] **Step 1: Write failing tests:** `ok fixture passes` (`ok === true`); `photo_issue fixture passes`; one test per rule that mutates a clone of the ok fixture and expects `ok === false` and a violation starting with the rule code: status ok + `blueprint: null` → `SCHEMA:` or `STATUS:` (accept either); status `photo_issue` with blueprint present and issues → `STATUS:`; routine steps `[1,1,3]` → `ROUTINE:`; only one `top_near_face` → `PALETTE:`; duplicate hex → `PALETTE:`; instructions without any "mm" → `BARBER:`; `card_why.summary = "Si veľmi atraktívny, 8/10"` → two `BANNED:` violations, one path contains `card_why.summary`; neutral words `"Pekne upravené obočie"` and `"hodnotenie proporcií"` → still `ok === true` (no false positives).
- [ ] **Step 2:** Run → FAIL. **Step 3:** Implement. **Step 4:** Run → PASS.
- [ ] **Step 5:** Commit `feat: add blueprint guardrails`.

### Task 4: Request parsing

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/lib/analyze/request.ts`
- Test: `src/lib/analyze/request.test.ts`

**Interfaces:**
- Produces: `parseAnalyzeRequest(body: unknown): { ok: true; value: AnalyzeRequest } | { ok: false; error: string }`; `export const MAX_PHOTO_BYTES = 1_500_000`.
- Error strings are short English codes for logs/UI mapping: `body_not_object`, `missing_photo:<key>`, `photo_not_jpeg:<key>`, `photo_too_large:<key>`, `invalid_height`, `invalid_hair_type`, `invalid_style`, `invalid_locale`, `measurements_not_supported`.
- JPEG check: base64 string starts with `/9j/`. Decoded size = `Math.floor(b64.length * 3 / 4) - padding`. Missing `locale` defaults to `"sk"`; missing `measurements` → `null`. Extra unknown top-level keys are ignored.

### Task 5: Model client + analyze orchestration

**Files:**
- Create: `src/lib/analyze/model-client.ts`, `src/lib/analyze/analyze.ts`
- Test: `src/lib/analyze/analyze.test.ts`, `src/lib/analyze/model-client.test.ts`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `buildSystemBlocks`, `buildUserContent`, `toModelSchema` (Task 3), `checkBlueprint` (Task 2), `AnalyzeRequest` (Task 4), schema JSON.
- Produces:
  - `interface VisionModel { generate(input: ModelInput): Promise<ModelOutput> }`
  - `ModelInput = { system: Anthropic.TextBlockParam[]; content: Anthropic.ContentBlockParam[]; outputSchema: Record<string, unknown> }`
  - `ModelOutput = { text: string | null; stopReason: string | null; usage?: { input_tokens: number; output_tokens: number; cache_read_input_tokens?: number | null } }`
  - `createAnthropicModel(opts?: { model?: string; effort?: "low" | "medium" | "high" | "xhigh" | "max"; client?: Anthropic }): VisionModel` – `client.beta.messages.create({ model, max_tokens: 16000, betas: ["server-side-fallback-2026-07-01"], fallbacks: "default", system, messages: [{ role: "user", content }], output_config: { effort, format: { type: "json_schema", schema: outputSchema } } })`; `text` = first `text` block's text or `null`. No `thinking` param (adaptive is default on this model). Defaults from `process.env.ANTHROPIC_MODEL ?? "claude-opus-5-5"` and `process.env.ANTHROPIC_EFFORT ?? "medium"`. If the installed SDK's types reject `fallbacks`/`betas`, check `node_modules/@anthropic-ai/sdk` typings for the documented name before working around it, and report what you found.
  - `createFixtureModel(): VisionModel` – returns `blueprint-ok.sk.json` as text with `stopReason: "end_turn"` after a 1500 ms delay.
  - `isFixtureModel(model: VisionModel): boolean`
  - `getVisionModel(): VisionModel` – fixture when `process.env.ANALYZE_MOCK === "fixture" && process.env.NODE_ENV !== "production"`, otherwise Anthropic.
  - `analyzePhotos(req: AnalyzeRequest, model: VisionModel): Promise<AnalyzeResult>`; `AnalyzeResult = { ok: true; response: BlueprintResponse; attempts: 1 | 2 } | { ok: false; reason: "refusal" | "invalid_output" | "model_error"; attempts: 1 | 2; violations?: string[] }`.
- Algorithm: attempt 1 with no corrections. Outcome per attempt: model throws → `model_error`; `stopReason === "refusal"` → return `{ok:false, reason:"refusal"}` immediately (no retry); `text` null, `JSON.parse` fails, or `stopReason === "max_tokens"` → violations `["PARSE: …"]`; else `checkBlueprint`. If attempt 1 fails for any reason other than refusal → attempt 2 with `corrections = violations` (for `model_error`: no corrections). Attempt 2 failure → `invalid_output` (or `model_error` if it threw).

- [ ] **Step 1: Write failing tests** with a fake `VisionModel` (array of scripted outputs / throws, records inputs): valid JSON first → `ok, attempts 1`, model called once, `outputSchema` has no `minItems`; invalid then valid → `ok, attempts 2`, second call's last content block contains the first violation; invalid twice → `{ok:false, reason:"invalid_output", attempts:2}`; refusal → `{ok:false, reason:"refusal", attempts:1}`, called once; throws then valid → `ok, attempts 2`; throws twice → `reason "model_error"`; `max_tokens` with truncated text → retried. `model-client.test.ts`: `getVisionModel()` with `ANALYZE_MOCK=fixture` and `NODE_ENV=test` returns a model whose output parses to the ok fixture; with `NODE_ENV=production` it does not return the fixture model (assert by checking it is not the fixture instance, e.g. an exported `isFixtureModel(model)` helper). `createAnthropicModel` with an injected fake client (object with `beta.messages.create` spy) sends `model: "claude-opus-5-5"`, `max_tokens: 16000`, `fallbacks: "default"`, `output_config.format.type: "json_schema"`, `output_config.effort: "medium"`.

  - `blueprintSimilarity(a: Blueprint, b: Blueprint): number` – Jaccard index over the feature set `{"cut:"+cut_name, "transition:"+transition, "mm:"+top+"/"+sides+"/"+back, ...palette hex lowercased prefixed "hex:", ...key_cuts item lowercased prefixed "cut_item:"}`.
  - `findGenericPairs(results: { case_id: string; blueprint: Blueprint }[], threshold = 0.8): { a: string; b: string; similarity: number }[]` – pairs at or above threshold.
  - `compareObservations(expected: EvalCase["expected"], actual: BlueprintResponse): { field: string; expected: string; actual: string; match: boolean }[]`.
  - `renderReport(run: EvalRun): string` – Markdown with sections: Summary (cases, ok count, valid JSON %, guardrail violations count, mean/p95 latency ms, total input/output/cache-read tokens), Per case table (case_id, status, attempts, latency, observation matches), Generic pairs, Violations. Never includes photo data or file paths of photos.
- CLI: `npm run eval -- --photos <dir> --cases <file.json> [--out eval/out]`. For each case: read 3 files, `sharp(...).rotate().resize({width:1024,height:1024,fit:"inside",withoutEnlargement:true}).jpeg({quality:85})` (rotate applies EXIF orientation; sharp drops metadata by default), base64, `analyzePhotos` with a wrapper model that measures latency and captures `usage`. Writes raw JSON outputs to `<out>/<case_id>.json` and report to `eval/reports/YYYY-MM-DD-runN.md` (N = next free number). Exit code 1 if any case fails schema/guardrails.
